sections.title: Headline
sections.content: AI agents dominate the daily signal, but the strongest individual surge comes from gods-eye-view, a browser-based spatial-intelligence globe. The list also shows local inference, multimodal creation, and production developer tooling moving together.

sections.title: JustVugg/colibri
sections.description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
sections.why_notable: Local inference and efficient model runtimes are drawing unusually strong attention.

sections.title: ever-co/ever-gauzy
sections.description: Ever® Gauzy™ - Open Business Management Platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM) - https://gauzy.co
sections.why_notable: Shows continued demand for broad, self-hostable business platforms.

sections.title: bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
sections.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser, except the data is real. Live open source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe.
sections.why_notable: The largest star gain in this snapshot combines geospatial data, 3D visualization, and a compelling browser demo.

sections.title: tech-leads-club/agent-skills
sections.description: The secure, validated skill registry for professional AI coding agents. Extend Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and more with absolute confidence.
sections.why_notable: Agent extensibility is moving toward registries, validation, and reusable skills.

sections.title: melgarafael/DeskcommCRM
sections.description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
sections.why_notable: AI agents are being embedded into practical, self-hosted vertical software.

sections.title: calesthio/OpenMontage
sections.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files.
sections.why_notable: Extends agent orchestration from coding into a multi-step creative workflow.

sections.title: vxcontrol/pentagi
sections.description: Fully autonomous AI Agents system capable of performing complex penetration testing tasks
sections.why_notable: Security automation remains a visible, high-interest application of autonomous agents.

sections.title: multimodal-art-projection/YuE
sections.description: YuE2: frontier music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic music editing.
sections.why_notable: Generative media is broadening from text and images into controllable music production.

sections.title: yuliskov/SmartTube
sections.description: Browse media content with your own rules on Android TV
sections.why_notable: Long-running consumer tools still break through when they solve a clear platform-specific problem.

sections.title: alphaXiv/OpenResearch
sections.description: Turn your coding agents into research agents
sections.why_notable: Agent workflows are expanding into literature and research automation.

sections.title: debpalash/VoiceStudio
sections.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.
sections.why_notable: The second-largest gain here points to strong interest in local, multimodal voice tooling.

sections.title: alibaba/open-code-review
sections.description: Fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset.
sections.why_notable: Production-grade developer tooling is pairing deterministic checks with LLM agents.

sections.title: jihe520/MathModelAgent
sections.description: An Agent Designed for Mathematical Modeling; automatically completes math modeling and generates a submission-ready paper.
sections.why_notable: Specialized agents are targeting complete domain workflows, not just chat interfaces.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agentic workflows; local and multimodal AI; developer and security tooling. Python leads with 4 repositories; TypeScript and Go have 3 each; C, JavaScript, Java, and Rust have 1 each.

sections.title: Notable Shifts
sections.content: The daily list emphasizes complete task-oriented systems connecting agents to domain data, tools, media pipelines, and operational software, while local execution remains prominent.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: Today’s momentum favors end-to-end AI products and workflows, especially coding-agent infrastructure, local inference and voice, creative generation, and applied automation.
